name: Veiled Advance
summary: Units from this detachment may make a Normal move of up to six inches before the first battle round begins, and may not end that move within nine inches of an enemy unit.

name: Massed Fire
summary: Ranged weapons of units from this detachment gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability while targeting a unit contesting an objective marker.

name: Veiled Advance
summary: Units from this detachment may be set up in Reserves and arrive from any battlefield edge from the second battle round onwards.
